title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A missing parser thread no longer stalls indexing forever
summary: Node does not report a missing worker file when the thread is created, but a moment later. The code expected the opposite, so its fallback never engaged and every Kotlin file waited forever.

highlights.title: An extension that silently did nothing
highlights.description: A dead thread went back into the pool, work was handed to it, and Node accepts that silently while the answer never comes. No error, no diagnostic, no index.

highlights.title: Parsing falls back to the main thread
highlights.description: Which is what it did before background threads existed. Work already waiting when the last thread dies is released rather than left hanging.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: A partial install, a build that did not finish, or an antivirus quarantine is enough to reach it.
Four ways of breaking the repair now fail the tests that cover it.
